doc: The part of build_flow that does NOT depend on the random draws (asserted equal over seeds 0..19), per body of params.names: the four flow scalars (hadley_deg, jet, trades, polar_easterlies; weak shear 0.3 / 0.1 / 0 and hadley 90 where there is no storm track), the number of cyclones and of anticyclones per hemisphere (north, south), both exactly m = max(2, round(x)) with x = 2 pi cos(track) / (5 L_R) (output wavenumber_x, NaN for a body without a storm track; Python round is half-to-even, the floor 2 is taken by threshold_below_50), and 0 for a body without a storm track (including every no-spin row), and the constant ascent weight per kind (cyclone 1, anticyclone -0.45, tropical 1.6) and the age of the non-cyclones (1), both asserted over the seeds. The 16 wave_<k>p5_below/above bodies put x 5e-5 (relative) below and above k + 0.5 for k = 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11, 14, 20 (m = k below, k + 1 above), so a wavelength factor (the 5 of 5 L_R) or a deformation radius off by more than 0.005 per cent changes m on one of them; no row sits exactly on a half-integer (the round-half-to-even tie is not pinned, it depends on the last bit of the libm). The input table holds NaN (a None or NaN period), +inf, 0, -0 and +-1e300 periods: no spin, no storm track. A port with any random generator must reproduce all of it exactly (scalars and wavenumber_x rtol 1e-9). Exact for the integers. NaN and infinities may appear in the inputs (a rotation period None is stored as NaN) and in the outputs: NaN equals NaN, an infinity equals the same infinity (sign included).

params.note: a NaN rotation period stands for None or NaN: both mean no spin
